page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top. Left margin: vertical side note text running up the left edge. Central diagram: braces linking columns "Suadendum" and "Dissuadendum" with numbered topics on the left. Below the diagram: "Suasio" and "Dissuasio" under a brace, "Probanda." under a second brace, then two columns of short lists (affirmative left, negative right), then a closing paragraph at full width with a catchword-like word at the foot.

main_text.p: Eorum, qua in deliberationem cadunt, haec sunt precipua.
main_text.l: 1. Bellum, Pax, Indutiae, Fedus | Quod iniri debeat | Quod iniri non debeat.
2. Dux exercitus, classis praefectus | Quod creandus | Quod non creandus
3. Civitates, ciuiues, parces | Quod muniendae | Quod non munienda
4. Trajectio, commeatus | Quod concedenda | Quod non concedenda.
5. Consuetudo. | Quod introducenda vel servanda. | Quod non introducenda vel servanda.
6. Lex. | Quod ferenda vel usu firmanda. | Quod non ferenda vel usu firmanda.
7. Meritum. | Quod praemio afficiendum. | Quod praemio non afficiendum.
8. Census, onera, tributum. | Quod imponenda. | Quod non imponenda.
main_text.p: In regula sint loci topici dialectici. Nominatim tamen suasio & dissuasio, amplificantur ex circumstantiis rei, personae, loci, tempus.

page.notes: Left margin vertical text is a side note, not transcribed as a main line. Diagram structure is approximate; several words in the braces are doubtful and some printed words in the dissuasion column are hard to read at this resolution. The final word "tempus" is partly cut off at the margin.
